tools.name: search_grants
tools.description: Search the public GrantCue grant catalog (federal, state, local and foundation opportunities) with the same filters as the Discover page. Returns a short page of matches, at most 25, and can reach the first 100 results of a search. Grant text is provided by the funders.

tools.name: get_grant
tools.description: One public catalog grant in full: dates, amounts, eligibility, and links to the funder’s own pages. A grant that is not publicly listed is not found.

tools.name: search_funders
tools.description: Search the foundations that have a public GrantCue profile (built from the latest Form 990-PF, or Form 990 Schedule I for community foundations and other grantmaking charities), largest givers first. Search by name, city, state or EIN, by the state they mainly give to, or for those that publish how

tools.name: get_funder
tools.description: A foundation’s public GrantCue profile, from the latest Form 990-PF, or Form 990 Schedule I for community foundations and other grantmaking charities: giving totals, typical and median grant, giving by year, where it gives, the 25 largest grants its latest filings report, and for a 990-PF filer how
